config.receiver_design: HFM envelope acquisition; independent known-tone Doppler pilots; fractional-time payload correction

truth_isolation: Receiver receives only rx, public cfg, nBits, and compensation flag. Truth appears only in this validation harness.
low_snr_scope: 0 dB cases are stress characterization, not required zero-error checks. Detection failures and BER are retained in the CSV.
false_alarm_scope: Zero observed false alarms in 50 tests is not proof of zero false-alarm probability; exact one-sided bound is reported.
